The Cethe Mod adds one powerful new item — the Cethe Glove!
Wield the energy of pure electricity in your hand and shock anything that stands in your way.

🧤 Cethe Glove – A high-tech electric weapon that channels lightning with every strike.
Use it to blast mobs, defend yourself, or show off your power in style!

Harness the storm — become the lightning itself. so play the mod today
